title: Student Clubs and Chapters
aliases: how do I join a club
content: VIT-AP has more than 70 student clubs and chapters spanning Technical, Non-Technical, Regional, Professional, and Social Outreach categories. Examples include the ACM Student Chapter, IEEE Student Branch, Computer Society of India, GeeksforGeeks VIT-AP Student Chapter, Machine Learning Club, Open Source Community: VIT-AP, NextGen Cloud Club, SEDS Aurora, and the Uddeshya social outreach club, among many others covering technology, culture, and social causes.
